scope: New-state spherical observer with the unchanged PR13 native samples, fixed GP covariance and shared RV/amplitude profiling. Conditional scores and displayed residuals are descriptive, not significances or evidence.
physical_state_scope: The input is a supplied physical snapshot. Physical-root qualification must come from its separate root review; this observer driver does not establish equilibrium.
observer: Dayside curved disk plus halo; prescribed dark transparent nightside; same 4500 K inner boundary, rotation, zonal flow, R=98000 convolution and stellar normalization.
sensitivity_scope: Alternate pixels use the same archived GP hyperparameters, with the covariance/projector recomputed for that pixel selection; covariance is identical between the two templates within each selection.
band_convention: Inverse-white-variance means in the original display bins; total=planet+conditional GP, residual=data-total. By-night/order summaries retain the globally profiled nuisance parameters.

baseline.message: CONVERGENCE: RELATIVE REDUCTION OF F <= FACTR*EPSMCH

physical_response.convention: Local branch S=eta/alpha in the wavenumber convention. Optical depths use each shell's radial width and rest-frame line profiles, without continuum or intercell Doppler shifts; actual observer transfer retains all velocities. Ratios are candidate/baseline. Undefined zero-denominator ratios are null.

optimizer_scope: All coarse/fine, primary/alternate, baseline/candidate two-start L-BFGS-B nuisance profiles report success. These are local optimization controls, not a proof of a global optimum. Five distant RV starts spanning the full allowed interval also converge to the same minimum within 1e-9 in Q for both templates and both pixel selections; no global-optimum claim is made.
band_error_scope: Band weights and independent-bin white standard errors are display diagnostics. Common-reference projection and the GP correlate bins; these are not full uncertainties or detection significances.

free_model_reference.scope: Reference rows only; baseline and new physical candidate remain the primary comparison. Free model 1 retains its plane geometry. The observation operator and frozen GP hyperparameters match the physical-template comparison. No model-1 shape or nuisance refit was performed here.

free_original.scope: Original free shape fixed; only its archived RV/amplitude fit is reused.

free_refitted.scope: Five shape parameters plus RV were previously optimized on the primary native data; the high-resolution shape was then fixed and RV/amplitude profiled. This has extra shape freedom compared with the physical templates.

nuisance_multistart.scope: Distant RV starts with the same saved fine templates, native data, fixed GP covariance, and nuisance bounds. A local-optimizer control, not a proof of a global optimum.
